Thulhagiri Island Resort
Lovers Paradise
The island is situated in North Male’ atoll approximately 13 km from the airport and takes only 20 minutes by Speed Boat from Male' International Airport.
Thulhagiri offers the perfect balance of an unspoiled tropical island with all the natural beauty and comforts.
-->
-->
The Lover Paradise
This small island 31,544 sq meters(7.8 ac) is surrounded by a vast white sandy beach and is covered densely with many beautiful tall shady palm trees and vegetation filled with chiming birds.
This resort is ideal for those who are looking for a small private island at close proximity to Airport with just 50 Beach rooms and 17 Water bungalows & 20 Superior Water Bungalows.
READ MORE

Hotel Policy
Thulhagiri Island is located a 20-minute Speed Boat journey from Male International Airport, International flight details must be provided 72 hrs prior to arrival for arranging the transfers to the hotel.
Every effort will be made to arrange your resort transfer within 2 hours. Departing guests will be transferred to the airport at least 3 hours in advance of the scheduled international flight departure time.
Check-in time is at 02:00 pm and Check-out time is 12:00 Noon
Rates are per room per night for double occupancy
Rates are inclusive to 10% service charge, 17% GST and Government
Green Tax of USD12.00 per person per night will be charged additional
Additional beds: Maximum 01 (90*190cm)
Child Policy
0.0 to 1.99 years Full complimentary transfer, baby cot and meals.
2.00 to 11.99 Years 50% off adult seaplane transfers.
Transfers
Thulhagiri Island is located a 20-minute Speed Boat journey from Male International Airport. Return transfers are USD 150 net per adult and per Child USD 75.
Every effort will be made to arrange your resort transfer within 2 hours. Departing guests will be transferred to the airport at least 3 hours in advance of the scheduled international flight departure time.
Meal Plans / Supplements
Half Board Half Board is included in all packages.
Includes: Buffet breakfast and buffet dinner at restaurant.
Full Board USD$ 30 per adult per night.
Includes: Buffet breakfast, buffet lunch and buffet dinner at restaurant.
Half Board plus USD$ 50 per adult per night.

All-Inclusive USD$ 75 per adult per night.

Compulsory Christmas Eve Dinner: USD$ 100 / Child USD$ 50
New Year-s Eve Dinner: USD$ 100 Per Adult / Child USD$ 100
All Price is quoted in USD $ and is inclusive of 10% Service charge, a further 17% T.G.S.T
*Prices are subject to change without any prior notice, therefore please check with hotel reception for the final updated prices.
Guarantee Details
Reservation must be guaranteed with one of these cards: Master card or Visa
Deposit Policy
A deposit of full amount will be charged to your credit card at the time of reservation.
Cancellation Policy
Cancellation Policy will be advised at the time of booking confirmation.
Notes
All pricing is quote and charged in US$
Bringing in or import of Liquor / Alcohol is prohibited in the Maldives and will be confiscated on arrival.

Thulhagiri Island Resort and Spa Maldives
Thulhagiri is situated in North Male’ atoll approximately 13 km from the airport and takes only 20 minutes by speed boat from Male' international airport.
Thulhagiri offers the perfect balance of an unspoiled tropical island with all the comforts.
Special Features
Barefoot concept Island.
Traditional Maldivian style design with Bamboo Furnitures.
Outdoor showers in all the Beach Villas.
Around the Island House reef for snorkelling.
Located just 20 Minutes by Speed Boat from the Male International Airport.
Home for thousands of birds (Budgies), wake up to the sound of their chimes.
Getting Here
Thulhagiri Island Resort and Spa is located in the Heart of North Male' Atoll, Republic of Maldives. 20Minutes Speedboat from Male' International Airport. Our boats are available to pick you up from the Airport at any time of the day. Our Transfers are combined with other guests.
International flight details must be provided 3 days prior to arrival for arranging the transfers to the resort. Failed to provide the flight information may result in paying for a private speed boat transfer.
Every effort will be made to arrange your resort transfer within 2 hours of arriving. Departure guests will be transferred to the airport at least 3 hours in advance of the scheduled international flight departure time.
Seasons
There are two distinctive seasons in the Maldives:
High Season
November to April is considered as the high season and often required to do advance bookings during this season to visit.
Low Season
May to November is considered as low season, you may find the best available rates with great offers during this season to visit.
